content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The Gram Panchayat (GP) plays several key roles in MGNREGA registration [E02]: (1) It verifies that the household is a legitimate entity, that applicants are local residents, and that applicants are adult members [E02]. (2) The verification process must be completed within a fortnight of receiving the application [E02]. (3) Once a household is found eligible, the GP issues a Job Card within a fortnight of the application [E02]. (4) The Job Card is handed over to one of the household members in the presence of other GP residents [E02]. Additionally, registrations are opened throughout the year at the GP office, and applications can be submitted there [E01].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E02"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"The GP verifies household eligibility including whether the household is a legitimate entity, applicants are local residents, and applicants are adults","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"Verification must be completed within a fortnight of receiving the application","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"The GP issues a Job Card within a fortnight if the household is found eligible","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"The Job Card is handed over to a household member in the presence of other GP residents","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"Registrations are opened throughout the year at the GP office","evidence_ids":["E01"]}]}
